title: P4PP: Precision 4-Point Probe system for automated sheet-resistance measurement (firmware, GUI, CAD/STL, documentation)
description: This repository accompanies the manuscript "Democratizing Lab Automation through Multi-Agent-Assisted Design and 3D Printing" (Hwang et al., submitted to Digital Discovery, 2026). P4PP is an automated four-point-probe platform with motorized probe landing and sample rotation, an LM334 current source with per-cycle shunt current readback, an ADS1220 24-bit ADC, and DPDT relay polarity reversal for delta-mode measurement. The repository contains the Arduino Nano 33 IoT firmware, the customtkinter host GUI, STL files, the bill of materials, and wiring, measurement and implementation guides.
notes: Code, design files and documentation released with the manuscript; see the repository README for build and usage instructions.
